site.placeholder: https://your-shop.com or a feed link (Google Merchant / YML)
site.helpShort: The platform is detected automatically: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and Squarespace are read through their catalogs, other sites through the sitemap and schema.org markup. The most reliable path is a Google Merchant or YML product feed link. Re-running the analysis updates prices and stock.
site.help: The platform is detected automatically. Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento and Squarespace are read through their open catalogs (100 products per request). PrestaShop, OpenCart, Wix, Tilda, 1C-Bitrix, InSales and any other site are read through the sitemap and schema.org markup (JSON-LD or microdata); this is slower, as every page loads separately. The most reliable path for any CMS is a Google Merchant or YML product feed link. The currency is set from the products. Re-running the analysis updates prices and stock.

tips.outOfStock: {{n}} products are out of stock: the agent will say so and suggest alternatives.
tips.good: The catalog is in good shape. Next step: store terms in Settings and the widget code or the agent link.

social.title: Social media: products and services from posts

widget.title: Widget
widget.brandHint: Taken from the website during the catalog analysis; you can change it here.
widget.greetingHint: The first line in the widget. Filled in automatically after the analysis; you can edit it.
widget.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! I can help you choose a product and answer questions about delivery.
widget.startersHint: Up to 4 lines, one per line. Empty = automatic from the catalog: one set for services, another for products; “Delivery terms” only when delivery is described in the terms.
widget.startersPlaceholder:
What services do you offer?
Show me examples of your work
How do I request a quote?
widget.notes: What the agent should know and offer
widget.notesHint: Free text: a phone or messenger for quick contact, who handles wholesale and complex requests, booking or catalog links, current promos. The agent gives these contacts and links in its replies when relevant.
widget.notesPlaceholder:
Quick contact: WhatsApp +48 600 000 000, 9am–8pm
Wholesale from 50 pcs: manager Anna, +48 600 000 001
Book a consultation: https://calendly.com/…
If asked for urgent delivery: 2–3 days, urgent orders by phone
widget.voiceHint: A few words: “warm and brief”, “expert, formal”.
widget.languageHint: The agent answers in the customer's language; this is the fallback.
widget.mic: Microphone button (speech recognition in the customer's browser)
widget.codeHint: Paste before </body> on every page (like an analytics tag). Tilda: Site settings → More → HTML code for head/body. Shopify: theme.liquid. WordPress: any “Header and Footer scripts” plugin.
widget.pixelHint: Place it on the “Thank you for your order” page with the order number and total. The purchase is matched to the visitor's conversation from the last 7 days and appears in reports.
widget.shareHint: Send the link in WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram: it opens the agent full-screen. In messengers it unfolds into a card with the cover and description below.
widget.coverAuto: automatic: color, logo and product photos
widget.shareTitleHint: Filled in automatically after the catalog analysis; you can edit it.
widget.shareDescriptionHint: Also automatic; briefly: what customers can ask the assistant.
widget.shareDescriptionPlaceholder: Ask the assistant: it picks products and answers questions
widget.previewHint: The preview updates as you edit. “Save” applies the changes on the site. Conversations from the preview appear in the Conversations section.
widget.appNameHint: One word under the icon, up to 12 characters ({{n}}/12). Empty = first word of the store name. The icon is your uploaded logo.

merchant.title: Owner agent
merchant.intro: Ask about sales, products and stock. The agent only proposes price and listing edits: you apply them with the button on the right.
starters: What was asked for but is not in the catalog?
merchant.placeholder: For example: raise the price of “…” by 10% and explain what changed this week
merchant.auditPrompt: Run a catalog quality audit: which items lack a photo, description, price or category, which names are unclear to shoppers, what to fix first. Give a list of concrete edits.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileHint: What you do, city, opening hours, what you don't do, how to address customers. The agent reads this on every turn.
settings.profilePlaceholder:
Store “…” sells … in Warsaw and ships across Poland and the EU.
Open Mon–Sat 10–20, closed on Sunday.
No wholesale. We address customers formally and reply in their language.
settings.termsLabel: Delivery, payment, returns, warranty, how to book
settings.termsHint: The agent answers questions about terms ONLY from this text. Write in sections: “Delivery”, “Payment”, “Returns” and so on.
settings.termsPlaceholder:
# Delivery
Poland: InPost Paczkomat 1–2 days, 12.99 zł, free from 200 zł; DPD courier 1–2 days, 16.99 zł.
EU: DPD / DHL 3–5 days, from €9.90.

# Payment
BLIK, card, Przelewy24, PayPal, Apple Pay.

# Returns
14 days from receipt, no questions asked (EU law), item unused. Refund within 14 days.

# Warranty
2 years under EU law.
settings.checkoutHint: Where the “Go to checkout” button leads. Empty → website address.
settings.currencyHint: Detected automatically from product prices during the website analysis. Needed so the widget shows prices, and for CSV files without a currency column.
settings.anthropicText: The agents run on Claude models. Your own key is billed directly to you; without it the platform key is used (if the superadmin has set one).
settings.anthropicHow: Where to get it: console.anthropic.com → Settings → API keys → Create key. A linked card or a top-up (Billing) is required. The key starts with sk-ant-api.
settings.geminiText: Gemini reads social media videos during the deep analysis (speech and on-screen text). Your own key means your own limits; without it the platform key is used.
settings.geminiHow: Where to get it: aistudio.google.com/api-keys → Create API key. There is a free tier; the key starts with AIza.
settings.notLikeKey: This does not look like a {{vendor}} API key: it starts with “{{prefix}}…”, {{n}} characters. The key starts with {{expected}}. If the browser autofilled a password, clear the field and paste the key again.
settings.modelMerchantHint: Reports and catalog edits: depth of analysis matters.
settings.modelsFromApi: List received from Anthropic for your key ({{n}} models). Press “Save” at the top after choosing.
settings.modelsStatic: Standard list: after connecting a key, all models available to your account will appear.
settings.wipeText: All products will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.sourcesHint: Site, Instagram, TikTok, Telegram channel: the agent reads them and builds the catalog itself.
settings.pixelsHint: Each store has its own ids. They work on the bot page opened by link: PageView, card view, cart, lead. Retargeting and lookalike audiences are set up in the ad accounts.
settings.pixelMetaHint: Meta Events Manager → Data sources → Pixel → 15–16 digit id
settings.pixelTiktokHint: TikTok Ads Manager → Assets → Events → Web → Pixel ID (e.g. C1A2B3…)
settings.consentHint: Turn on if your customers are in the EU/EEA, the UK or California. Pixels do not load until “Accept”; the chat’s own data (visitor id, messages) is needed for the service and requires no consent. Without the banner pixels fire immediately — the store owner is responsible for compliance.
settings.consentEnabled: Show the consent banner on the bot page
settings.privacyUrlHint: Linked from the banner. Required in the EU: who the controller is, what data, purposes, retention, how to withdraw consent.
